notes: Run of 2026-10-28. 15 Romolo reopening earns an entry; the Chronicle's Saam review names no address.

findings.description: 15 Romolo, the North Beach cocktail bar in the 114-year-old Basque Hotel building on Romolo Place, closed August 2024 for renovation and is to reopen next month. Address is the bar's name, confirmed in the article ('named for its address on Romolo Place').

extra.building_candidates: Basque Hotel (former name), built about 1912; closed as hotel 1996. Article states building is 114 years old.
